coverage.original_language: A selected mathematical-papers modern LaTeX reader draft is front-facing.
coverage.translation: Current English translation reader contains clean batches 01-09, including invariant theory, finite-group invariant theorems, rational representation of invariants, absolute irreducibility, formal variational calculus, polynomial ideals and resultants, elimination theory, abstract ideal theory, Hilbert numbers, group characters, hypercomplex quantities, the principal genus theorem for relatively Galois number fields, split crossed products and maximal orders, ideal differentiation and the different, and cyclic applications.
